map.计算踢腿高度与身高比例，评估柔韧度等级与踢腿技术: Computes the ratio of kick height to body height and evaluates the flexibility grade and kicking technique
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：Math.asin(min(1,kh÷(ll+h×0: Core formula (by input variables): Math.asin(min(1,kh÷(ll+h×0.5)))×180÷π; kh÷ll×100; kh÷h×100

map.武术/跆拳道训练评估：输入身高、腿长（缺省按身高45%估算）、踢腿离地高度与踢腿: Training assessment for martial arts and taekwondo: enter the height, leg length (estimated at 45% of height by default), the height of the kick above the ground and the kick type, and the tool computes the height ratio, leg-length ratio and estimated angle, quantifying flexibility and technique.
map.技术动作比对：不同类型踢法（前踢/侧踢/旋踢/后踢/高踢）有不同高度系数，工具按: Comparing techniques: different kicks (front / side / roundhouse / back / high) have different height coefficients, and the tool grades by the adjusted height ratio for easy comparison across kicks.
map.安全提示：用于设定训练目标高度，避免过度追求高度拉伤；角度估算仅供参照，实际受髋: Safety note: use it to set training target heights so you do not strain yourself chasing height; the angle estimate is for reference only, since the real angle also depends on hip mobility.
map.算例：170cm 身高、前踢离地 165cm: Worked example: height 170 cm, front kick 165 cm above the ground
map.身高 170cm、腿长缺省=170×45%=76.5cm、踢高 165cm、前踢:
Height 170 cm, default leg length = 170 × 45% = 76.5 cm, kick height 165 cm, front kick (coefficient 1.0).
Height ratio = 165/170 × 100 = 97.1%; leg-length ratio = 165/76.5 × 100 = 215.7%; estimated angle = asin(165/(76.5 + 85)) × 180/π = asin(1.0) = 90.0° (the limit is reached, and the formula truncates anything beyond it); adjusted height ratio = 97.1%/1.0 = 97.1% → grade good (≥ 85%). This means the kick can reach above head height.
map.高度比和腿长比怎么理解？: How should the height ratio and leg-length ratio be understood?
map.高度比=踢高÷身高×100%，反映相对身高能踢多高；腿长比=踢高÷腿长×100%: Height ratio = kick height ÷ body height × 100%, reflecting how high you can kick relative to your height; leg-length ratio = kick height ÷ leg length × 100%, reflecting how far it exceeds the leg length. Using both avoids comparing absolute heights alone and ignoring differences in build.
map.踢腿角度是怎么估算的？: How is the kick angle estimated?
map.按腿长与身高比例近似：角度=asin(踢高÷(腿长+半身高))。该式是简化模型，: It is approximated from the leg length and the height ratio: angle = asin(kick height ÷ (leg length + half the height)). This is a simplified model; the actual kick angle also depends on hip mobility and torso posture, so it is for training reference only — never chase height blindly and risk a strain.
